name: katazuku-shukatsu
description: Local-first, human-in-the-loop automation core for Japanese shukatsu (new-grad job hunting). SQLite single-writer data model, semantic layer, and a schema-driven settings UI.
author: kokotatan

scripts.check: npm run scan && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run cloudflare:check && npm run google-auth:check
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:application && npm run test:mobility && npm run test:agent-runtime && npm run test:platform && npm run test:migration && npm run test:write-layer && npm run test:api && npm run test:schema && npm run test:recording && npm run test:workflows && npm run test:viewer && npm run test:spark-gateway && npm run test:setup && npm run test:google-connect && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:google-workspace
scripts.test:agent-runtime: tsx tests/check-agent-runtime.ts && tsx tests/check-spark-handoff.ts && tsx tests/check-spark-queue.ts && tsx tests/check-spark-transport.ts && tsx tests/check-providers.ts
scripts.cloudflare:check: npm run cloudflare:types && tsc -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json && wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.example.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm pack --dry-run && node tools/check-npm-release.mjs
scripts.test:spark-gateway: npm --prefix spark-gateway ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix spark-gateway run check
scripts.test:desktop: npm --prefix desktop run check && tsx tests/check-desktop-config.ts
scripts.google-auth:types: wrangler types --config google-auth/wrangler.example.jsonc --env-interface OAuthEnv --strict-vars false google-auth/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.google-auth:check: npm run google-auth:types && tsc -p google-auth/tsconfig.json && wrangler deploy --config google-auth/wrangler.example.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.test:google-workspace: node tools/google-workspace/check.mjs && tsx google-auth/check.ts && tsx google-auth/check-connection.ts
